newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks build slightly on rally in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks build slightly on rally in afternoon.

text.p: Thai stocks built slightly on a morning rally when market reopened for the afternoon session on Wednesday as most large capitalised stocks were limit up and little was left to buy, brokers said.
The composite SET index rose 7.89 percent or 41.60 points to 568.56 on 6.9 billion baht turnover at 0812 GMT.
Brokers said prices of blue-chip stocks in banking, finance and communication stocks had hit ceiling now and investors would have to wait until tomorrow before they could buy more.
